item.title: 【Qiita】 LangChainで履歴を渡しているはずなのにAIが忘れる — 会話メモリが3ターンで飛ぶ3つの原因と完全な直し方
item.description: 「前の質問も覚えていてください」と指示したチャットアプリを動かしたら、会話が3ターン目で壊れました。「私の名前は何？」と聞いたユーザーに対し、AIは「存じ上げません」と返したのです。過去の会話はキレイにプロンプトへ渡している。原因を調べてもエラーは出ない。丸1日溶かしてよう...

item.title: 【AI4S】 Filter By:
item.description: Metal halide perovskite nanocrystals (PNCs) are promising candidates for next-generation optoelectronics. However, their commercial application necessitates low-cost synthesis and processing methods that surpass conventional lab-scale techniques. To address this, we report a ligand triggered room-temperature injection (LTRI) method that initiates nanocrystal nucleation by tuning precursor reactivity with addition of short-chain octanoic acid (OcA). Subsequently, integrating automation synthesis and machine learning, we further develop an efficient AI-accelerated framework towards fast and target synthesis of the FAPbI3 (FA: formamidinium) PNCs. Leveraging machine learning modeling, we identify that the critical size and distribution of FAPbI3 PNCs can be effectively optimized by tuning the feed ratio of OcA to the precursor formamidinium acetate. Furthermore, our LTRI method is fully compatible with flow-synthesis system for scale-up production, enabling a substantial reduction in production cost to US$2.16 g−1, significantly lower than the widely adopted hot-injection method (US$118.81 g−1). For practical application, we achieve a power conversion efficiency of 19.37% in photovolt
